| description = These golems reside behind the mushroom maze on the route to Trak's lair and within his lair itself. They were a popular target for small raids from budding raid guilds who needed to build an inventory of Kunark-era lvl 55+ spell scrolls. Their stiff HP pool and inaccessibility behind dozens of mushrooms generally put them out of reach of single groups.

Statics respawn at 27 minutes, pathers at 21 minutes.
